verification_matrix.note: each criterion is a failure the plan must make impossible; PASS = the failure scenario cannot be produced

criteria.name: byte-identical-double-generation
criteria.failure: two catalog->adapter generations of the same surface differ
criteria.oracle: diff gen1 gen2 == 0 bytes for every surface; no Date.now()/RNG in adapters

criteria.name: effective-config-explain
criteria.failure: a live surface value cannot be traced to a catalog row+adapter+precedence rung
criteria.oracle: explain <surface> <key> prints source row, adapter, precedence winner for every key

criteria.name: clean-session-parity
criteria.failure: a fresh clean session loads config diverging from the generated candidate (drift-in)
criteria.oracle: boot clean session; loaded set == generated set (no unexplained +22 drift-in)

criteria.name: semantic-parity
criteria.failure: generated config semantically differs from reconciled baseline (missing server/event/skill)
criteria.oracle: set-equality on MCP names, 17 Claude + 10 Codex hook events, skill list

criteria.name: no-dup-registrations
criteria.failure: >1 Stop registration; duplicate MCP across scopes; double hook wiring
criteria.oracle: scan all settings layers -> exactly ONE owned Stop; each MCP once per scope; CI drift-assertion

criteria.name: concurrency-safety
criteria.failure: two concurrent deploys interleave -> torn/partial live config
criteria.oracle: single-writer lock serializes; loser aborts cleanly with receipt; no torn file

criteria.name: malformed-config-recovery
criteria.failure: an adapter emits invalid JSON/TOML and it reaches live
criteria.oracle: candidate validation fails -> deploy aborts -> live untouched (byte-identical to pre-deploy)

criteria.name: crash-recovery
criteria.failure: kill deploy mid-write -> torn/half-written live file
criteria.oracle: per-file atomic os.replace -> each file old-complete or new-complete; parity re-run repairs

criteria.name: stale-lock-recovery
criteria.failure: a dead owner's lock permanently blocks all deploys
criteria.oracle: lock owner-PID + mtime-TTL; dead/expired lock safely stolen; a LIVE owner still blocks

criteria.name: interruption-atomicity
criteria.failure: SIGINT mid-multi-file deploy leaves inconsistent live set
criteria.oracle: per-file os.replace all-or-nothing; receipt records partial+resumable; re-run converges

criteria.name: bad-candidate-rollback
criteria.failure: a candidate failing post-write parity is left live
criteria.oracle: restore-on-mismatch auto-reverts to pre-deploy backup; live == pre-deploy; receipt logs it

criteria.name: deploy-from-clean-tree
criteria.failure: deploy sources the dirty working tree (a sliver leaks live)
criteria.oracle: source is git archive HEAD ci/harness only; dirty-tree deploy refused

criteria.name: receipt-provenance
criteria.failure: a deployed file has no digest / source_commit=null (live!=git undetectable)
criteria.oracle: every receipt carries bundle digest + non-null source_commit; live-digest == committed-digest assertion

criteria.name: stop-reentrancy-cannot-reproduce-boundary
criteria.failure: a future Stop-capable module without its own guard re-opens the loop
criteria.oracle: A1 T4: synthetic always-inject module + re-entrant Stop -> native output empty {}

criteria.name: stop-reentrancy-exit-contract
criteria.failure: re-entrant Stop emits non-empty output / non-zero exit
criteria.oracle: A1 T5: subprocess re-entrant Stop -> exit 0, stdout {}\n, stderr empty

criteria.name: deliberate-live-edit-detected
criteria.failure: a hand-edit of a deployed projection goes unnoticed
criteria.oracle: edit a live projection -> SessionStart drift gate surfaces it; live-digest != committed-digest flags

criteria.name: harness-change-must-be-doc+PR
criteria.failure: a harness/MCP/skill/hook change commits with no doc+manifest+toolchain PR
criteria.oracle: ENFORCE: pre-commit block fails the commit; SHADOW: logs only, never blocks (ladder honored)

criteria.name: gem-backport-gate
criteria.failure: an adopted skill with no source in source/skills ships
criteria.oracle: doc-reconciliation gate FAILS the no-source adoption (S-BP/S-RC4 canonical test)

criteria.name: cleanup-safety
criteria.failure: cleanup --forces past a dirty/unmerged/owned worktree -> uncommitted loss
criteria.oracle: cleanup refuses on dirty tree; enumerates uncommitted delta + main..branch + mapped stashes; salvage-ack; quarantines live-owned domains

criteria.name: fail-open
criteria.failure: an enforcement-hook exception blocks the session
criteria.oracle: any hook exception -> exit 0; ladder advances only after zero-false-block burn-in

criteria.name: per-agent-timeout-no-deadlock
criteria.failure: one hung agent in parallel() stalls the whole phase indefinitely
criteria.oracle: H6: hung node timed-out and killed; cohort completes; .filter(Boolean) tolerates null

criteria.name: stall-heartbeat
criteria.failure: an agent with no progress > STALL_MS hangs silently
criteria.oracle: stall-heartbeat flags/escalates at STALL_MS (90s); no silent > threshold hang in telemetry

criteria.name: monitoring-parity-codex-threadid
criteria.failure: a mingled Codex node is PID-killed (kills ALL Codex sessions) or invisible in the monitor
criteria.oracle: Codex threads keyed by threadId, never process-killed; wfmon shows vendor rollup native/cross-vendor/codex-only

criteria.name: secrets-absent
criteria.failure: a secret VALUE appears in a generated surface, receipt, telemetry, or export
criteria.oracle: gitleaks/redaction gate clean; only ${VAR} placeholders; export redaction fail-closed with N masked banner

criteria.name: both-memory-store-bypass-fixed
criteria.failure: a recall consults only one store; the MEMORY.md-bypass regression persists
criteria.oracle: a recall touches BOTH basic-memory + MEMORY.md; diagnosed bypass has a regression test that fails pre-fix

criteria.name: exactly-once-replay
criteria.failure: a memory outage drops or double-replays a spooled event
criteria.oracle: outage->spool->recovery replays each event exactly once under an injected-outage test

criteria.name: budgets-enforced
criteria.failure: a regression blows startup/context/RAM/latency/disk/daemon budget unnoticed
criteria.oracle: /harness-audit scorecard CI gate asserts each budget; a deliberate over-budget change FAILS the gate
